ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms triage labels, owners and the close-without-disposition flag are declared; it does not show issues were actually triaged.
offer: Route issues using meaningful labels and an accountable owner. Closing a report needs a written disposition or proving fix; inactivity alone does not resolve the problem.

minimal.reason: List the labels used to route issues. Unlabelled reports are not routed, so name the label set the repository uses.

mid.reason: Name the owner responsible for each triage lane. Without an accountable owner reports stall, so assign people or teams.

maximal.reason: Set closing without a disposition to false. Inactivity alone does not resolve a report, so close only with a written reason or a proving fix.
